goal: Calculate delivery fee in integer cents.
scope: Pure function shipping_fee(cents, member=False), no payment or network calls.

acceptance.description: Non-member cart below 10000 cents costs 799 cents.
Cart at or above 10000 cents has free delivery.
Member with a nonnegative cart has free delivery.
Negative cart raises ValueError for both member states.

assumptions.text: Inputs are integer cents; validation of other types is outside this task.
assumptions.impact: Other types have no acceptance guarantee.
